Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 14, "heading": "CHAPTER 12. LIKING LIFE ON MY OWN ACCOUNT NO BETTER, I FORM A GREAT RESOLUTION", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u014-b0061", "target": "— Лады, за шестачок! — сказал длинноногий молодой человек и тотчас вскочил на свою тележку, которая была не чем иным, как большим деревянным подносом на колёсах, и загрохотал с такой скоростью, что мне стоило всех сил поспевать за ослом.", "source_sha256": "95ca4efe3c919ba58da79aed5d281bce357a18967a5c9e0d8d1474783873c9f3", "target_id": "ru-en85-u014-b0061", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "72e341740b8a8973e5e4448bb7b132bee854cfd837e52f6708a6802ef88cd4a5"}, {"source_id": "en85-u014-b0062", "target": "В этом молодом человеке была какая-то вызывающая манера, особенно в том, как он жевал соломинку, разговаривая со мной, и она мне не слишком нравилась; но раз уговор был заключён, я отвёл его наверх, в комнату, которую покидал, и мы спустили сундук и поставили его на тележку. Теперь мне не хотелось прикреплять там карточку с адресом, чтобы кто-нибудь из семейства моего хозяина не догадался, что я затеял, и не задержал меня; поэтому я сказал молодому человеку, что буду рад, если он остановится на минуту, когда доедет до глухой стены тюрьмы Королевской Скамьи. Слова едва сорвались у меня с языка, как он загрохотал прочь, словно он, мой сундук, тележка и осёл были все в равной мере безумны; и я совсем запыхался, бегя за ним и окликая его, когда настиг его в назначенном месте.", "source_sha256": "d74417a3db4026f010bfdd535d81ef31a97fd8ff21021e5ce2347e130f2e903f", "target_id": "ru-en85-u014-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "df674b9adfa17a25e57326b4734e2387e49668c516802c9d8ec1933efd42f58f"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 12, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u014-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Being much flushed and excited, I tumbled my half-guinea out of my pocket in pulling the card out. I put it in my mouth for safety, and though my hands trembled a good deal, had just tied the card on very much to my satisfaction, when I felt myself violently chucked under the chin by the long-legged young man, and saw my half-guinea fly out of my mouth into his hand.", "sha256": "d9bb618988ec13bef4ef8b62c15d982da4cab7d10807cada4d35cdc2fb30c3c4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[19]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u014-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Wot!’ said the young man, seizing me by my jacket collar, with a frightful grin. ‘This is a pollis case, is it? You’re a-going to bolt, are you? Come to the pollis, you young warmin, come to the pollis!’", "sha256": "f667322a73af1ad6e68915926212be008f7bb06d487b14618e8284d8293eda7e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[19]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u014-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You give me my money back, if you please,’ said I, very much frightened; ‘and leave me alone.’", "sha256": "a796b6bf498b8fe55d12472dd9f26b21be32231eab8c1f7e8da67af63ad80afd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[19]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u014-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Come to the pollis!’ said the young man. ‘You shall prove it yourn to the pollis.’", "sha256": "6f0d411bfd050ae2c63da506a43443a879d3c7b022593eb396ef5b7431aa36d5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[19]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u014-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Give me my box and money, will you,’ I cried, bursting into tears.", "sha256": "1a2031f355bb708346660c9f7c88769a553cfbcd529cc162ba1b91b174c7dfcf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[19]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u014-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The young man still replied: ‘Come to the pollis!’ and was dragging me against the donkey in a violent manner, as if there were any affinity between that animal and a magistrate, when he changed his mind, jumped into the cart, sat upon my box, and, exclaiming that he would drive to the pollis straight, rattled away harder than ever.", "sha256": "0249dbc02bf8a07e82b1939cd8d41aeedf8d50176f31e32836f223ea578e61f1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[19]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u014-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I ran after him as fast as I could, but I had no breath to call out with, and should not have dared to call out, now, if I had. I narrowly escaped being run over, twenty times at least, in half a mile. Now I lost him, now I saw him, now I lost him, now I was cut at with a whip, now shouted at, now down in the mud, now up again, now running into somebody’s arms, now running headlong at a post. At length, confused by fright and heat, and doubting whether half London might not by this time be turning out for my apprehension, I left the young man to go where he would with my box and money; and, panting and crying, but never stopping, faced about for Greenwich, which I had understood was on the Dover Road: taking very little more out of the world, towards the retreat of my aunt, Miss Betsey, than I had brought into it, on the night when my arrival gave her so much umbrage.", "sha256": "2a81d3f5de746aa9f2d69497e80f86703935898d2b51e43db55e42bd5e515e34", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[19]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
